953092:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, turn on the power and activate the Pack-A-Punch elevator.
- Equip your gun with the Dead Wire Ammo Mod and take the elevator from the bottom to the top.
- While the elevator is going, there are three electrical boxes that need to be shot in order:
   1. [Electrical Box](#loc=953093)
   2. [Electrical Box](#loc=953094)
   3. [Electrical Box](#loc=953095)
- Once all are shot, head to the Living Quarters and shoot the [Electrical Box](#loc=953096) there, then on the other side of the wall, in the Rec Yard, shoot the last [Electrical Box](#loc=953097).
- This will open the door next to the final Electrical Box. Head inside and shoot the zombie named Anya Tonovsky underneath the shelf.
- Pick up the [EMF Fob](#loc=953098) and head to the Sea Tower.
- Use it to open the briefcase on the table and grab the [Multiphastic Resonator](#loc=953099) inside.
- Head back to the Research Lab and place the Multiphastic Resonator inside the [Research Lab Machine](#loc=953100).
- The code that needs to be input can be acquired in two ways:
   - Option 1:
      - In the back of the Research Lab are two [Formula Boards](#loc=953101). 
      - Head around the map and activate three laptops:
         - [Laptop](#loc=953102)
         - [Laptop](#loc=953103)
         - [Laptop](#loc=953104)
      - After they are activated, sticky notes will appear on the Research Lab Machine that correlates the symbols on the board to the X, Y, and Z values.
         - Find the symbol on the board. The left number is the number in the tens digit, and the bottom number is the number in the ones digit.
      - Using Algebra, solve the three equations on the board in order to get the full code to put into the machine.
   - Option 2:
      - After a couple of rounds, head to Peck in the Guard Station and interact with the computer to receive the code immediately for 5,000 essence.
         - You can avoid paying the price by cooking a normal fish, using the knowledge from the [Culinary Delight Easter Egg](#loc=953182), picking it up instead of eating it, then giving it through the slot next to Peck.
- After a few rounds complete, the Multiphastic Resonator will be charged.
- Pick up the Multiphastic Resonator, head to Castle Rock Island, and interact with the [Blue Orb](#loc=953105).
- A zombie will spawn in glowing blue. Kill the zombie, pick up the orb it drops, and bring it into the large orb.
- After doing this two or three times, pick up the Resonator and head to Crab Island and interact with the [Green Orb](#loc=953106) there, repeating the process.
- Finally, head to Temple Island and complete the last [Purple Orb](#loc=953107), which will drop the [AMP Munition](#loc=953108).
- Pick it up and build the wonder weapon at the [Workbench](#loc=953109) in the back of the Research Lab.

953110:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, acquire the Beamsmasher Wonder Weapon from the [Beamsmasher Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=953092).
   - The Beamsmasher can also be acquired in the mystery box.
- With the Beamsmasher, head to the [Tentacle Traps](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-terminus?search=tentacle_trap%20%26%26%20category%3A27396) around the map and find the one with the broken grate above.
- While the trap is active, shoot the tentacles with the Beamsmasher to drop the [Hard Drive](#loc=953111).
- Head back to the Guard Station and give the Hard Drive to Peck and Strauss.
- Next, three numbers need to be found around the map:
   - The first number is whatever the hour hand is set to on the [Clock](#loc=953112) in the Interrogation Room.
   - The second number is the value of the [Playing Card](#loc=953113) on the wall of the Mess Hall.
   - The third number is how many days since the last injury on the [Safety First Poster](#loc=953114) in the Engineering room.
- After acquiring all the numbers, head to the Bio Lab and input the code, in order, into the [Containment Device](#loc=953115).
- Each player in the game needs to interact with a valve on the Containment Device to release Nathan.
- After defeating Nathan, grab the [Key Card](#loc=953116) and head to the underside of the Shipwreck to access the secret room.
- Inside it, grab the [Connection Tool](#loc=953118) and survive the lockdown.
- Place the two Connection Tools into two of the three spots around the map (One of them will already be filled):
   - [Node Connection](#loc=953119)
   - [Node Connection](#loc=953120)
   - [Node Connection](#loc=953121)
- Head back to the Guard Station and grab the [Hacking Device](#loc=953122) from Peck and Strauss.
- With the Hacking Device, head to three different buoys around the map and hack each one quickly:
   - [Buoy](#loc=953125)
   - [Buoy](#loc=953124)
   - [Buoy](#loc=953123)
- Once all are hacked, head to the Bio Lab and quickly disarm the three bombs around the room:
   - [Bomb](#loc=953126)
   - [Bomb](#loc=953127)
   - [Bomb](#loc=953128)
- Interact with the door next to the [Melee Macchiato perk machine](#loc=945907) to start the boss fight.

953172:
**Steps:**
- First, acquire [Melee Macchiato](#loc=945907) and head to the Sea Caves.
- Melee the loose rocks in front of the [Hidden Treasure Room](#loc=953167) and interact with the skeleton.
- An X will show up on the map. Head to the location marked and swim around to acquire a Watch.
- Head back to the Hidden Treasure Room and interact with the skeleton. 
- Three X's will show on the map, corresponding to three skeletons that appear around the map:
   - [Skeleton](#loc=953168)
   - [Skeleton](#loc=953169)
   - [Skeleton](#loc=953171)
- At each skeleton, throw a thermal grenade or a molotov on top of it to spawn an HVT.
- After killing each HVT, grab the Cursed Coin that it drops and take it back to the skeleton in the Hidden Treasure Room.
   - Each coin will reward loot when turned in.
- After all three coins are turned in, a last X will be marked on the map.
- Head to the location and survive three rounds for lightning to strike, leaving behind a chest. Open the chest to acquire the [Cursed Talisman](#loc=953173), increasing the zombie kill reward but decreasing your essence when you take damage.
